# VoltMapEV

> VoltMapEV is an EV charging station discovery and range-aware trip-planning application for India.

Canonical site: https://voltmapev.com/
Public guide: https://voltmapev.com/ev-charging-stations-india.html
Contact: skotla100@gmail.com, +91 93927 88714

## Public features

- Search EV charging stations by PIN code, area, city, or state.
- Review Government of India aggregate public-charger totals.
- Plan EV routes and see relevant demonstration chargers near the route.
- Open current external map results and directions for travel verification.

## Data and payment transparency

The Government of India aggregate total is sourced and dated. Bundled station locations, availability, prices, route stops, and payments are demonstration data and are not a complete live inventory. The current checkout is a sandbox and does not accept or move real money.
